property.statement: Before a scoped FileSystemCAS write publishes any new durable intent or ownership claim, every explicitly bound manifest must match the resolved write owner tenant and exact cell identity. Package intake preflights all selected views; retry/resume and generic put use the same predicate.
runtime_path: PutOptions / ArtifactManifest tenant_context from native producers
put_bytes/put_json -> _put_blob_and_manifest_once -> resolved scoped owner -> common bound guard -> intent -> bytes/profile -> durable blob/view/default claims
historical pending put -> _resume_publish_transaction -> reconstructed manifest -> common guard before staging/mutation

archive/directory/import_exact_view -> validated complete payload + manifest profiles -> _publish_staged_import -> all-view common guard under lease before first intent -> publication -> read/recovery
CachingArtifactStore._populate_local -> passive exact profile custody; scoped durable backend retains admission responsibility
NodeResultCache + NCM selected-view + MeasurementRoot system-tenant/cell-None actual consumers
property.surface: scoped get_manifest/get_bytes/has, reopened filesystem consumers, real exact-profile cache and typed pending refusal; production served authority surface not established by this bounded slice
property.proxy_divergence: A cryptographically valid blob/profile and successful byte import can still mint tenant-B/cell-B durable claims for a manifest explicitly bound to tenant-A/cell-A. Base probe does that; field existence/hash/inventory markers cannot distinguish it. Helper-body removal keeps marker/call sites but recreates 27 real refusals failing.
negative_controls: same-tenant None-cell vs scoped-cell in both directions
mixed package valid first + foreign-bound last refuses before any intent/claim
existing matching default cannot hide a foreign-bound selected view
pending mismatched put/import replay refuses before touching intent or bytes
generic JSON/bytes sibling emissions use same guard
pending read denial removal with actual final-link fault
directory live-generation writer and archive live-writer mutations fail independent byte/inventory checks

predicate_limits.declared_context_vs_scoped_owner: recomputed from validated manifest and existing resolved write owner under publication lease
predicate_limits.authority eligibility/completeness: not_established; this guard compares existing declared context only

source_refs.contract: declared tenant/cell context that owned an authority-bearing write; cell_id may be None
optional bound metadata; no new authority/SIK completeness rule
tenant context remains part of exact persisted profile
existing scoped tenant + normalized cell identity; None is a distinct identity
one active scoped owner; every bound manifest checked before new intent/claims; all import package views preflighted
actual consumer requires matching manifest/payload/cache tenant context
selected view tenant/cell is validated; None cell does not skip validation
passive unscoped raw cache preserves complete bound view; durable remote owner still guards scoped runtime access
optional query None means omitted expectation in this function only; not a wildcard rule for scoped durable identity

matrix.manifest: bound same tenant and exact cell (including None)
bound foreign tenant or unequal cell (including None vs scoped cell)
matrix.passive_unscoped_exact_cache: preserve exact profile; no scoped owner claim

matrix.active_scoped_owner: existing independently owned selected-view/physical-byte reuse behavior retained

source_contract.none_cell: An explicit persisted None cell is the unscoped-cell identity. It cannot equal cell-a or act as a wildcard. An omitted optional expected-field query in authority_reconciliation is a separate interface.
source_contract.missing_owner: Absence of active write owner remains legitimate passive custody. No blanket refusal for bound -> unscoped exact cache.
source_contract.intake_emission_enumeration: Tracked canonical store call paths: public put_bytes/put_json and retry -> put/resume guard; export bridge archive/directory and import_exact_view -> all-view guard; cache population exact copy -> same import; legacy _record_write_owner/_record_write_view_owner methods have no tracked callers. Explicit metadata-free administrative record_artifact_owner is outside this declared bound-manifest emission class and remains named residual.
